headline: Google Forms: Collect info effortlessly
body: Need to gather feedback on a new product idea? Create a quick survey with Google Forms and share it with your audience.
caption:
Google Forms is a really handy tool for collecting information, whether you're gathering sign-ups for a workshop, feedback from clients, or survey responses for your next big project. It's super easy to set up and customize, helping you get the insights you need without any fuss. Since it's part of Google's free suite of tools, you can always access its core features.
